technical_and_design_decisions: All new code will target Java 17+ and Spring Framework 6.x to align with the specification's stated minimum version requirement for Spring 6.0.

Lattice bare metal infrastructure provisioning (U4) will use Terraform for infrastructure as code (IaC) to ensure reproducible, version-controlled environment setup.
The dot-delimited property resolution feature (U5) will extend Spring Cloud Stream's existing PropertyResolver abstraction to reuse existing property binding and validation logic.
Mesos deployment support (U7) will leverage the existing Spring Cloud Mesos integration (if available) or build a lightweight wrapper around the Mesos HTTP API to minimize custom orchestration code.
The extracted Redis test rule (U8) will be published as a standalone Maven/Gradle library with no dependencies on internal s-c-d modules to ensure it can be consumed by external projects.

All user stories are independent and can be implemented in parallel without conflicting changes to shared core components of the s-c-d codebase.
